leila: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands  need a one-line status + single next action for each at-risk booking so exec can triage. I'll watch for 20m.

owen: Sales summary (super terse):
- AtlasWorks: $410k ARR, blocker = SOC2 evidence + legal SLA. Next action: send SOC artifact bundle + schedule 30m CISO call. Owner: owen.
- EmberAI (via partner Skyforge): $275k ARR, blocker = partner resource backlog for POC. Next action: offer 48h engineering wedge + partner checklist; owner: nina.
- ClearPay (renewal): $130k ARR, blocker = pricing carve-out request. Next action: propose 30-day onboarding credit and short-term price protection. Owner: harry.

nina: Partner note: Skyforge needs a single technical contact and a clear checklist. If we approve the wedge, I can coordinate their schedule and deliver the checklist.

harry: Finance/legal: I can draft the onboarding credit and short-term price protection addendum today. ETA: EOD.

zoe: Product impact: wedge + SOC push is ~1 sprint of re-prioritization for routing perf work. If leadership prefers revenue protection, we should reassign 2 engineers this sprint.

leila: Recommendation: prioritize AtlasWorks and EmberAI this week (highest ARR/exposure). Action items I'll capture: 1) owen send SOC pack + call invite today, 2) nina book wedge + post checklist, 3) harry draft credit/addendum, 4) scheduler-bot schedule 30m rescue standup tomorrow 09:00 PST.

scheduler-bot: Calendar event created: "Midquarter pipeline rescue"  2025-09-08 09:00 PST. Invitees: leila, owen, nina, harry, zoe. Link: https://calendar.internal/evt/2100012345

owen: Sending SOC bundle to AtlasWorks CISO now, will post sent link.

nina: I'll confirm Skyforge availability and post the wedge engineer name by EOD.

harry: Draft addendum posted: https://docs.internal/credits/clearpay-2100012345. Please review.

leila: Thanks team  I'll bring the ARR-risk metric to the rescue call. If anything changes before then, update this thread.
